name: CorpusIQ
description: Hosted CorpusIQ MCP server for cross-source business data. Connect Google Analytics, Search Console, Google Ads, Meta Ads, QuickBooks, Stripe, HubSpot, Shopify, Klaviyo, Airtable and 40+ other systems, then ask one business question in any MCP client and get a single answer with the sources it came from. External retrieval is read-only and customer data is not stored. Requires a CorpusIQ account with a free trial, no credit card required; sign in with OAuth.
